fullDescription: A MINIMAL SWISS / INTERNATIONAL-STYLE DECK SYSTEM (16:9) built as repeatable layouts. Cool paper #e9ecee ground, near-black ink, and ONE ultramarine #1c39c4 spike as the only accent. The rule that governs everything: emphasis comes from WEIGHT + COLOR, never SIZE - one calm type size, meaning carried by a bolder weight and a few ultramarine words/numbers. Content is held in a wide LEFT column with a large empty margin; a single HAIRLINE RULE is the only ornament. Layouts: COVER (mono rail + hairline + weight-emphasis headline), NUMBERED AGENDA (01-04 in tabular-nums ultramarine, hairline-separated rows), and a PLAYFAIR closer line. Reusable for design/engineering reviews, field-notes decks, quiet product updates, and any considered, restrained presentation.
prompt:
## Resumo
A MINIMAL SWISS / INTERNATIONAL-STYLE DECK SYSTEM at 16:9 (1600x900 slides), designed as REPEATABLE layouts whose entire personality is restraint. GROUND: cool paper #e9ecee on every slide. COLOR: strictly cool paper + near-black ink #16191c + ONE ultramarine #1c39c4 — used as a SPIKE (a few emphasized words, agenda numbers, the italic closer word), never as a fill or a block. THE GOVERNING RULE: emphasis comes from WEIGHT + COLOR, never from SIZE — the deck runs at a near-uniform type size and meaning is carried by a bolder weight (e.g. Public Sans 800 on one word) plus the ultramarine spike; do not solve hierarchy by making things bigger. LAYOUT DISCIPLINE: content is held in a wide LEFT column (max-width ~88%) with a large empty right/bottom margin, flush-left; a single HAIRLINE RULE (1px) is the ONLY ornament anywhere. FURNITURE: a small MONOSPACE rail pinned top-left ('FIELD NOTES · 2026') and a small mono slide-label bottom-right, constant on every slide. TYPE SYSTEM: a clean grotesque (Public Sans; Inter/Helvetica Neue fallback) for headline + agenda at a calm size with selective weight; the CLOSER shifts register to PLAYFAIR DISPLAY (a serif) for one human line. THREE LAYOUTS: (1) COVER = mono rail + a short hairline rule + a headline where one word is bold + ultramarine ('Designing for calm, at scale.'); (2) NUMBERED AGENDA = 01-04 in tabular-nums ultramarine with each row separated by a hairline rule; (3) CLOSER = a single Playfair Display line with the italic ultramarine spike over a monospace cite. Invent generic copy — never a template brand.

## Estilo Visual
Design a MINIMAL SWISS / INTERNATIONAL-STYLE DECK SYSTEM at 16:9 as repeatable layouts. Ground: cool paper #e9ecee on every slide. Color: cool paper + near-black ink #16191c + ONE ultramarine #1c39c4, used as a SPIKE (a few words, agenda numbers, the closer word) — never a fill or block. GOVERNING RULE: emphasis from WEIGHT + COLOR, never SIZE — run a near-uniform type size and carry meaning with a bolder weight (Public Sans 800 on one word) + the ultramarine spike; never solve hierarchy by scaling up. Hold content in a wide LEFT column (max-width ~88%) with a large empty margin, flush-left. Use exactly ONE hairline rule (1px) as the only ornament. Furniture: a small MONOSPACE rail top-left ('FIELD NOTES · 2026') and a mono slide-label bottom-right, constant on every slide. Type: a clean grotesque (Public Sans; Inter/Helvetica Neue fallback) for headline + agenda at a calm size with selective weight; shift the CLOSER to PLAYFAIR DISPLAY serif for one human line. Build three layouts: a COVER (mono rail + short hairline + weight-emphasis headline), a NUMBERED AGENDA (01-04 tabular-nums ultramarine, hairline-separated rows), and a PLAYFAIR closer line with the italic ultramarine spike over a mono cite. Invent generic copy; never a real template brand.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Ground, wide margin, and constant furniture
Fill every slide with cool paper #e9ecee. Hold all content in a wide LEFT column (max-width ~88%), flush-left, leaving a large empty right/bottom margin. Pin a small MONOSPACE rail top-left ('FIELD NOTES · 2026', ~35px, .1em tracking, uppercase, muted grey) and a small mono slide-label bottom-right at ~50% opacity — both constant on every slide. No boxes, no color blocks, no shadows.

### Cover — weight-and-color emphasis, not size
On the cover, draw a short HAIRLINE RULE (1px, ink, ~36% width) as the only ornament, then anchor a headline low-left in a clean grotesque (Public Sans; Inter/Helvetica Neue fallback) at a calm ~160px, line-height ~1.02. Emphasis comes from WEIGHT + COLOR: run the sentence at a medium weight (~600) and make ONE word bold (~800) AND ultramarine #1c39c4 ('Designing for calm, at scale.'). Never make a word bigger to emphasize it — heavier and blue only.

### Numbered agenda — structure from hairlines
Build the agenda as 01-04 rows, each row separated by a 1px HAIRLINE rule (top and bottom on the set), no boxes. Numbers in monospace tabular-nums, ultramarine #1c39c4; items in bold ink at a calm size (~64px). The hairlines and the numbered rhythm carry the structure — add no color fills or icons.

### Closer — the Playfair register shift
For the closer, shift register to PLAYFAIR DISPLAY (serif): one line held in the left column (~105px, line-height ~1.18) with the emphasized clause in italic bold ultramarine ('The work isn't louder. It's quieter, on purpose.'), then a monospace cite beneath in muted grey. This single serif slide is the one human note in an otherwise grotesque deck — use it only to close.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Weight-and-color emphasis (never size) — The governing device: hierarchy carried by a bolder weight + a single ultramarine spike, at one calm type size.
Run the deck at a near-uniform type size and carry all emphasis with WEIGHT + COLOR: keep the base at a medium weight and make the emphasized word heavier (e.g. Public Sans 800) AND ultramarine #1c39c4. Never scale a word up to emphasize it. This restraint is the whole Swiss personality — one size, selective weight, one accent.

### Single ultramarine spike — One ultramarine #1c39c4 used only as a spike — a few words, agenda numbers, the italic closer word — never a fill.
Use ultramarine #1c39c4 as the ONLY accent, and only as a SPIKE: one emphasized word per headline, the agenda numbers, the italic closer clause. Never fill a shape or a background with it. On cool paper + near-black ink, the spike is the single point of energy the eye lands on.

### Hairline-only ornament + wide margin — A single 1px hairline rule as the deck's only ornament, with content held in a wide left column against large negative space.
Allow exactly ONE hairline rule (1px, ink) as ornament — a short rule under the cover title, and the row dividers in the agenda. No boxes, shadows, gradients, or icons. Hold all content flush-left in a wide left column (max-width ~88%) with a large empty right/bottom margin; the negative space is a design element, not leftover room.

### Playfair closer (register shift) — A single serif closing line (Playfair Display) with an italic ultramarine spike — the one human note in a grotesque deck.
Close on ONE Playfair Display serif line held in the left column, with the emphasized clause in italic bold ultramarine, over a monospace cite. This is the only serif and the only register shift in the deck — use it strictly to close, so the shift stays meaningful and the body stays quietly grotesque throughout.

style.description: International Typographic (Swiss) style: quiet, objective, guided by grid and negative space rather than ornament. Cool paper #e9ecee ground, near-black ink, and ONE ultramarine #1c39c4 spike as the only accent. The governing rule is that emphasis comes from weight and color, never size — one calm size across the deck, with a bolder weight and a few ultramarine words carrying meaning. Content is held in a wide left column with a large empty margin, flush-left; a single hairline rule is the only ornament. A monospace rail and slide-label are the constant furniture; a Playfair Display closer is the one register shift that lets a grotesque deck end on a human note. Considered, restrained, confident in its whitespace — the negative space does as much work as the type.
